purpose: Second verification addendum for provisional mechanism coverage. Canonical status remains unchanged until the repository promotion rule is applied by a dedicated review.

sources.title: The Low Breaking Fiber Mechanism and Its Effect on the Behavior of the Melt Flow of Injection Molded Ultra-Long Glass Fiber Reinforced Polypropylene Composites
sources.reportedFindingBoundary: Some operating conditions shortened 25 mm fibres to roughly 10 mm on average; the low-breakage mechanism could retain about 22 mm under its tested configuration.
sources.limitation: Special machine architecture, 25 mm L-FRP feedstock and test geometries are application-specific; the measurements establish the fibre-breakage mechanism, not universal screw-speed or gate settings.

sources.title: Study on the Influence of Runner and Overflow Area Design on Flow–Fiber Coupling in a Multi-Cavity System
sources.limitation: FRP material, overflow geometry and four-cavity layout are study-specific; experimental evidence supports cavity-specific flow-fibre imbalance but does not provide a universal runner balance rule.

sources.title: Mechanical and crystallization properties of hot runner injection molded virgin and recycled polypropylene
sources.limitation: This study verifies physical hot-runner process/property behaviour but does not independently measure every manifold/nozzle zone actual or valve actuation. It should be supporting evidence, not by itself proof that displayed hot-runner setpoints differ from actuals.

sources.title: In-mold rheology and automated process control for injection molding of recycled polypropylene
experimentalContext: five recycled-PP blends with broad flow-property distribution
sources.limitation: The tested rPP blends, control architecture, mould and sensor locations are study-specific; variability reduction does not establish a universal controller or material-equivalence rule.

sources.title: Influence of the Recyclate Content on the Process Stability and Part Quality of Injection Moulded Post-Consumer Polyolefins
experimentalContext: 16 mixtures of virgin and post-consumer PP/HDPE
sources.limitation: Specific post-consumer streams, blend ratios, compounding history and geometries; evidence supports variability and part-property sensitivity rather than interchangeability of recyclates.

sources.title: Silver streaks dependence on processing conditions in the injection molding of post-consumer recycled polypropylene
sources.publisher: CIRP Journal of Manufacturing Science and Technology / Elsevier
sources.limitation: The defect chemistry depends on contaminant inks/binders and recyclate history; process adjustments are source-specific and cannot be generalized as universal settings.

sources.title: Part-mass control in injection molding of recycled thermoplastics by learning-enabled model predictive cavity-pressure control
experimentalContext: virgin PP and two PCR batches
sources.reportedPerformanceContext: Mean part-mass deviation of 0.21% relative to the reference was reported during the tested transition sequence.
sources.limitation: This article and the RWTH dataset are the same experimental family and must never be counted as independent evidence from each other.

reviewRecommendations.fibre-breakage-retained-length: Now has two publisher-verified primary measured studies from independent groups with retained fibre length plus physical/mechanical outcomes; run canonical promotion review.
reviewRecommendations.runner-gate-multicavity-imbalance: Now has at least two publisher-level experimental candidates, but carefully check author-group overlap and whether physical cavity-quality outcomes satisfy the exact promotion rule.
reviewRecommendations.hot-runner-actual-behaviour: Evidence is stronger, but a second study measuring hot-runner actual thermal/mechanical state independently of commands/setpoints is still preferable before promotion.
reviewRecommendations.recyclate-process-variability: Multiple independent measured studies plus the RWTH data family now satisfy a strong evidence shape; run a dedicated overlap-group and physical-outcome promotion review.
